# NeuromorphicRoutingOptimization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An approach that optimizes the routing of spike packets across neuromorphic cores by minimizing address redundancy and improving data flow. This enhances the efficiency of iNEST-based systems, enabling faster and more energy-efficient spike propagation in large-scale SNNs.
